newsitem.title: UK: UK's Laura Ashley to close two factories.
newsitem.headline: UK's Laura Ashley to close two factories.

text.p: British fashion and textiles group Laura Ashley Holdings Plc said on Tuesday it was proposing to close down two loss-making garment sewing factories at Caernarfon and Machynlleth in Wales.
The group, which also announced a current trading statement, said the closure was part of a restructure plan that would affect about 190 employees.
The company, which issued its second profit warning in five months, said the restructure will result in a charge of around one million stg which will be reflected in first half results.
"It is the company's intention to source the products made at these two facilities overseas, achieving cost savings and improvements in quality," it said.

The company continues to employ 237 people at two other garment sewing facilities in Gresford and Oswestry and another 440 people are involved in home furnishing production and in administration functions in Wales.
The company's share price, which has witnessed a steady decline over the past few months, was firm, 1 1/2 pence up at 58p.
Laura Ashley, made famous by its floral dresses and taffeta party frocks, recently witnessed a series of management upheavals including departures of its main designer and merchandising director.
